description: This file defines a Twig extension class DebugExtension, which provides debugging functionality including a dump function to output variable contents for debugging purposes.

classes.name: DebugExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension providing a 'dump' function for debugging, capable of displaying variable states during template rendering.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig functions provided by this extension, notably the 'dump' function configured with context and environment considerations.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: A static method that outputs the content of variables or context for debugging, respecting debug mode and output safety.
